email.title: Sign in to {portal}
email.lead: We send you one e-mail with a sign-in link and a code. No password.
email.label: Work e-mail
email.hint: The address you were invited with.
email.failed: We could not send the e-mail right now. Try again in a minute.

check.running: One moment: we are checking that this is a person and not a program. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
check.failed: The check did not finish. Try again.

code.title: Check your e-mail
code.sent: If {email} is invited, we sent a link and a code. They work for 15 minutes.
code.lead: Open the link in the e-mail, or type the 6-digit code here: on this device, or on the one you read mail on.
code.label: Code from the e-mail
code.hint: 6 digits. You can paste the whole code.
code.triedOut: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
code.expired: This code has expired. We can send a new one.
code.format: Type the 6 digits of the code.
code.incomplete: Type the 6 digits of the code first.
code.failed: Sign-in failed on our side. Try again.

link.title: Continue to the {company} portal
link.why: Nothing happens until you press Continue, so a mail program that opens links by itself cannot use yours.
link.deadTitle: This sign-in link no longer works.
link.deadBody: A link works once and for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one with your work e-mail.
link.failed: Sign-in failed on our side. Try again.

first.title: Welcome to {portal}
first.lead: Two short confirmations, only this first time. You can change them later.
first.name: Your name
first.languageHint: The portal and its e-mails speak it.
first.summariesHint: For updates that are not urgent. E-mails about orders, deliveries and invoices always arrive as they happen.
first.termsFailed: The portal terms could not be loaded. Try again.
first.termsLanguage: Not ready in your language yet: shown in {language}.
first.accept: I have read and accept the portal terms of {company}.
first.acceptRequired: Accept the portal terms to go on.
first.failed: We could not save this right now. Try again.
first.termsChanged: The portal terms changed while you were reading. Read the new version and accept it again.

ended.title: You were signed out
ended.idle: You were signed out after 30 minutes without use. Sign in again to go on.
ended.revoked: Your session was ended. Sign in again to go on.

paused.title: Access paused
paused.PAUSED: Your access to the {company} portal is paused. Contact {contact}.
paused.ENDED: Your access to the {company} portal ended on {date}. Contact {contact} if you still need it.
paused.ENDED_undated: Your access to the {company} portal has ended. Contact {contact} if you still need it.
paused.INVITATION_ENDED: Your invitation to the {company} portal is no longer valid. Ask {contact} for a new one.
paused.PORTAL_OFF: The {company} portal is not switched on for your organisation yet. Contact {contact}.
paused.TERMS_NOT_PUBLISHED: The {company} portal is not open yet: its portal terms are not published. Contact {contact}.

unknown.title: Which portal?
unknown.none: This page does not know whose portal to open. Open the address in your invitation e-mail, or the link in your sign-in e-mail.
unknown.notFound: We do not know this portal address. Check the address in your invitation e-mail, or ask the company that invited you.

foot.invite: The portal is by invitation. Ask your contact at {company}:
foot.inviteNoContact: The portal is by invitation. Ask your contact at {company}.
foot.inviteAnonymous: The portal is by invitation. Ask your contact at the company that invited you.

privacy.title: Privacy notice of {company}
privacy.missing: No privacy notice is published at this address yet. Ask {company}.
privacy.missingAnonymous: No privacy notice is published at this address yet.
privacy.failed: The notice could not be loaded right now.
privacy.language: Not ready in your language yet: shown in {language}.
privacy.close: You can close this tab: the sign-in stays open in the other one.
